2608.21097.title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge
2608.21097.paper_summary: LLM-as-Judge systems can produce multi-dimensional evaluations, such as trustworthiness, reliability, and factuality, and these outputs are often interpreted as independent evidence. We test this assumption for a common pair of judgments: trust scoring and binary truth classification. On correctness-controlled QA, LLM judges align trust scores with truth verdicts more tightly than human behavioral reference, suggesting weaker separations between trust and truth judgment. We then apply stress tests by changing only source cues of identical QA between Human and AI. Source attribution shifts not only trust scores but also truth verdicts and logit-derived correct-side probabilities. Results show that current LLM-as-Judge protocols should not treat trust scores as independent evidence for truth judgments.
2608.21097.paper_summary_zh: LLM-as-Judge 系統可以產生多維度的評估，例如可信度、可靠性和事實性，這些輸出通常被解釋為獨立的證據。<lb/>我們測試這一假設，針對一對常見的判斷：信任評分和二元真實性分類。<lb/>在正確性控制的問答中，LLM 評判者將信任評分與真實判決的對齊程度比人類行為參考更緊密，這表明信任和真實判斷之間的分離較弱。<lb/>然後，我們通過僅改變人類和 AI 之間相同問答的來源提示來進行壓力測試。<lb/>來源歸屬的變化不僅影響信任評分，還影響真實判決和基於邏輯的正確側概率。<lb/>結果顯示，目前的 LLM-as-Judge 協議不應將信任評分視為真實判斷的獨立證據。
